title: arctostaphylos uva-ursi subsp. nummularia
intro: Arctostaphylos uva-ursi subsp. nummularia, commonly known as kinnikinnick, is a shrub plant native to North America, particularly in the western and mountainous regions. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits such as treating urinary tract infections, kidney stones, and diarrhea due to its antiseptic and astringent properties. The therapeutic actions of kinnikinnick include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which can help soothe and protect the mucous membranes and skin. The bioactive constituents of this plant include arbutin, hydroquinone, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
